text:
Casey (People Ops): kicking off Q4 "Bright Moments": snack boxes + $20 micro-spot awards. want quick alignment on opt-in, customs, manager approvals, and PO/GL. timeline ideas?
Rowan (Logistics): suggest opt-in to avoid returns. regional ship weeks: APAC week of Oct 3, EMEA Oct 10, NAM Oct 17. signature only for high-value orders.
Mei (HRBP): managers get a digest; one-click approve or decline. deadline 5 business days before each regional ship.
Theo (Finance): use GL-6140 (Culture spend). vendor PO needed 2 weeks before first ship. include 5% overage buffer.
Pri (Benefits): packaging must not show amounts. e-card holds award details. we'll prepare a one-liner tax note to include in e-card.
Sam (Vendor): vendor can do combo ship + e-codes. lead time 7 business days after PO. prefer CSV with name/email/address and a flag for "physical_opt_in".
Jo (Intern): quick headcount snapshot:
```
Region,Heads,OptInsEst
APAC,120,80
EMEA,210,150
NAM,300,200
Total,630,430
```
Casey (People Ops): thanks Jo. action items: 1) Jo: finalize opt-in CSV by Sep 10. 2) Casey: build manager digest + approval flow by Sep 12. 3) Theo: draft PO + confirm GL-6140 by Sep 14. 4) Pri: tax note copy by Sep 12. 5) Rowan: country blocklist for perishables by Sep 11.
Mei (HRBP): will include manager script reminding that cash payouts must go via payroll (payroll cutoff Sep 20 for Oct payroll).
Rowan (Logistics): small ask: mark physical as "promotional goods" on customs forms. Sam, ok?
Sam (Vendor): yes, we can label as promotional goods. also recommend insured shipping for plant-based items if any.
Casey (People Ops): agreed no plants this round to simplify customs. everyone good?
All: :thumbsup:
Casey (People Ops): I'll lock dates and post nomination link once Jo uploads the CSV. will ping here when manager comms is live. :sparkles:
